reviews.text: No pay out. It’s all a lie

Honestly a programmed scam. So when you get the app you earn a good amount of energy/points from doing the side games and stuff like that. But then when you finally hit the first pay out bracket of $30 the app resets so all your rewards for the side games, drinking water, and walking a certain amount of steps all goes down to 1 point/energy. But you are still watching ads like no tomorrow and when you email the pay out email the app gives you you don’t ever get a response on how to get the money you have supposedly earned in the app. It’s 100% a scam they made it just to play adds at people so they can pocket the ad revenue. Would not recommend downloading.
